page.overview:
Who is Ronnie Del Cooper?

Ronnie Del Cooper is a character in Cars 2. He is one of the many audience members in the World Grand Prix and is a huge Lightning McQueen fan.

Ronnie Del Cooper is one of the many fans who come to watch the World Grand Prix. He supports the American representative, Lightning McQueen. During the Tokyo leg, he is shocked when Rip Clutchgoneski spins out right in front of him.
